statement: The square roots of 1 + 4 Z_2 are determined to 2 digits (all branches).
argument: Not true as stated: 1 + 4 Z_2 is the union of 1 + 8 Z_2, where there are two roots, and 5 + 8 Z_2, where there is none. The ball is outside the guard N - m >= c + v(n) of docs/SPEC.md:633-634 (N - m = 2, c + v(2) = 3), so the expected answer is NOT_DETERMINED. Split into b5-1 and b5-2.
